'''Clemens A. van Blitterswijk''' (1957, [[The Hague]]) is a Dutch [[tissue engineering|tissue engineer]] who contributed to the use of biomaterials to heal bone injuries, especially using [[Osteopromotive|osteoinductive]] ceramics.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Miron|first1=R.J.|last2=Zhang|first2=Y.F.|date=August 2012|title=Osteoinduction: A Review of Old Concepts with New Standards|journal=Journal of Dental Research|language=en|volume=91|issue=8|pages=736–744|doi=10.1177/0022034511435260|pmid=22318372|s2cid=209326442 |issn=0022-0345}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|vauthors=Yuan H, Fernandes H, Habibovic P, de Boer J, Barradas AM, de Ruiter A, Walsh WR, van Blitterswijk CA, de Bruijn JD|date=August 2010|title=Osteoinductive ceramics as a synthetic alternative to autologous bone grafting|journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America|volume=107|issue=31|pages=13614–9|doi=10.1073/pnas.1003600107|pmc=2922269|pmid=20643969|bibcode=2010PNAS..10713614Y |doi-access=free}}</ref> In collaboration with Jan de Boer and others, he has contributed to screening microtextures to study cell-biomaterial interactions, an approach termed [[materiomics]].

== Career ==
Blitterswijk graduated from a bachelor in [[cell biology]] at [[Leiden University]] and defended his PhD thesis in 1985 at the same university on artificial ceramic [[middle ear]] implants under the supervision of Professor Jan Grote<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Van Blitterswijk|first1=C. A.|last2=Kuijpers|first2=W.|last3=Daems|first3=W Th|last4=Grote|first4=J. J.|date=January 1986|title=Epithelial Reactions to Hydroxyapatite: An in Vivo and in Vitro Study|journal=Acta Oto-Laryngologica|language=en|volume=101|issue=3–4|pages=231–241|doi=10.3109/00016488609132832|pmid=3705952|issn=0001-6489}}</ref> and [[Klaas de Groot]],<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=van Blitterswijk|first1=C.A.|last2=Grote|first2=J.J.|last3=Kuijpers|first3=W.|last4=Daems|first4=W.Th.|last5=de Groot|first5=K.|date=March 1986|title=Macropore tissue ingrowth: a quantitative and qualitative study on hydroxyapatite ceramic|journal=Biomaterials|volume=7|issue=2|pages=137–143|doi=10.1016/0142-9612(86)90071-2|pmid=3011138|issn=0142-9612}}</ref> for which he was awarded the Jean Leray young scientist award from the [[European Society for Biomaterials]] in 1987.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=ESB European Society for Biomaterials|url=http://www.esbiomaterials.eu/Cms/Content/7|website=www.esbiomaterials.eu|access-date=2020-06-01|archive-date=8 November 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211108192658/http://www.esbiomaterials.eu/Cms/Content/7}}</ref> From 1985 to 1996, he worked on [[hydroxyapatite]] biomaterials for middle ear implants under the mentorship of Jan Grote<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Nell|first1=M.J.|last2=Op't Hof|first2=B.M.|last3=Koerten|first3=H.K.|last4=Grote|first4=J.J.|date=1999|title=Effect of Endotoxin on Cultured Human Middle Ear Epithelium|journal=ORL|volume=61|issue=4|pages=201–205|doi=10.1159/000027671|pmid=10450054|s2cid=20788406|issn=0301-1569}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Bakker|first1=D.|last2=van Blitterswijk|first2=C. A.|last3=Hesseling|first3=S. C.|last4=Th. Daems|first4=W.|last5=Kuijpers|first5=W.|last6=Grote|first6=J. J.|date=June 1990|title=The behavior of alloplastic tympanic membranes inStaphylococcus aureus-induced middle ear infection. I. Quantitative biocompatibility evaluation|journal=Journal of Biomedical Materials Research|volume=24|issue=6|pages=669–688|doi=10.1002/jbm.820240604|pmid=2163404|issn=0021-9304}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|title=New Alloplastic Tympanic Membrane Material|last1=Jj|first1=Grote|last2=D|first2=Bakker|date=September 1991 |language=en|pmid=1665011|last3=Sc|first3=Hesseling|last4=Ca|first4=van Blitterswijk|journal=The American Journal of Otology|volume=12|issue=5|pages=329–35}}</ref> and Klaas De Groot<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=van Blitterswijk|first1=C. A.|last2=Hesseling|first2=S. C.|last3=Grote|first3=J. J.|last4=Koerten|first4=H. K.|last5=de Groot|first5=K.|date=April 1990|title=The biocompatibility of hydroxyapatite ceramic: A study of retrieved human middle ear implants|journal=Journal of Biomedical Materials Research|volume=24|issue=4|pages=433–453|doi=10.1002/jbm.820240403|pmid=2161412|issn=0021-9304}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Verheyen|first1=C. C. P. M.|last2=De Wijn|first2=J. R.|last3=Van Blitterswijk|first3=C. A.|last4=De Groot|first4=K.|date=October 1992|title=Evaluation of hydroxylapatite/poly(l-lactide) composites: Mechanical behavior|journal=Journal of Biomedical Materials Research|volume=26|issue=10|pages=1277–1296|doi=10.1002/jbm.820261003|pmid=1331112|issn=0021-9304}}</ref> at [[Leiden University]].

In 1996, he left [[Leiden University]] and co-founded, together with Klaas De Groot, IsoTis BV, a life sciences company focused on bone biomaterials and tissue engineering.

In 1997, he became a professor at [[University of Twente]]. Later, he was appointed director of the University of Twente's MIRA Institute for Biomedical Technology and Technical Medicine institute (the institute no longer exists). In collaboration with Jan de Boer, Hemant Unadkat, and Dimitrios Stamatialis, he contributed to the development of a high-throughput assay to design and select micrometer-scale surface textures that could enhance specific biological functions (TopoChip).<ref>{{cite journal | vauthors = Unadkat HV, Hulsman M, Cornelissen K, Papenburg BJ, Truckenmüller RK, Carpenter AE, Wessling M, Post GF, Uetz M, Reinders MJ, Stamatialis D, van Blitterswijk CA, de Boer J | title = An algorithm-based topographical biomaterials library to instruct cell fate | journal = Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America | volume = 108 | issue = 40 | pages = 16565–70 | date = October 2011 | pmid = 21949368 | pmc = 3189082 | doi = 10.1073/pnas.1109861108 | bibcode = 2011PNAS..10816565U | doi-access = free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | vauthors = Baker M | title = Trying out topographies | journal = Nature Methods | volume = 8 | issue = 11 | page = 900 | date = November 2011 | pmid = 22167818 | doi = 10.1038/nmeth.1760 | s2cid = 5421979 | doi-access = free | url = https://ris.utwente.nl/ws/files/6753725/trying.pdf }}</ref>

In 2012, he became a partner of the Life Science Partner (LSP) private investment firm where he invests in private companies and startups related to healthcare innovations.<ref>{{Cite web|title=LSP van Blitterswijk|url=https://www.lspvc.com/team/clemens-van-blitterswijk.html}}</ref>

In 2014, he became a distinguished professor at [[Maastricht University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.maastrichtuniversity.nl/research/distinguished-university-professors|title=Distinguished university professors – Research – Maastricht University|website=maastrichtuniversity.nl|access-date=1 February 2018}}</ref> Until 2018, he was the director and department chair at the MERLN Institute at [[Maastricht University]]. In 2015, he was awarded an [[European Research Council|ERC]] Advanced grant that aimed at developing [[Microfabrication|microfabricated]] and [[Microfluidic cell culture|microfluidic]] cell culture platforms for improving organoids.<ref>{{cite web|title=Press release Maastricht University|url=https://www.maastrichtuniversity.nl/news/major-european-grant-professor-clemens-van-blitterswijk|date=8 April 2016|website=Maastricht University}}</ref> The conception of this grant application and the research relative to it were done by several principal investigators at Maastricht University.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Geuens|first1=Thomas|last2=van Blitterswijk|first2=Clemens A.|last3=LaPointe|first3=Vanessa L. == Valorization ==
He has served as CEO of IsoTis.,<ref>{{cite web|title=IsoTis Orthobiologics Archives|url=https://www.seaspine.com/family/isotis/|website=SeaSpine}}</ref> a company that underwent an [[Initial public offering|Initial Public Offering]] and was subsequently acquired by [[Integra LifeSciences]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=IsoTis – Integra Merger|url=https://www.perssupport.nl/persbericht/7382/isotis-integra-merger|access-date=30 September 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION Washington, D.C. 20549 SCHEDULE 14A Proxy Statement Pursuant to Section 14(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1380180/000089256907001265/a34305defa14a.htm|access-date=30 September 2018}}</ref> In 2018, he became the chairman of the board of directors of Kuros Biosciences.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Professor Clemens van Blitterswijk|url=https://kurosbio.com/meet-the-team/professor-clemens-van-blitterswijk/|website=Kuros Biosciences|language=en-GB|access-date=2020-05-24}}</ref>

== Teaching ==
Blitterswijk has been the official supervisor of over 80 PhD candidates who, in their large majority, have worked in the laboratories of other faculty members. He has participated as an editor of four textbooks, including one dedicated to tissue engineering.<ref>{{Cite book|isbn=978-0-12-370869-4|title=Tissue Engineering|last1=Van Blitterswijk|first1=Clemens A.|last2=Thomsen|first2=Peter|year=2008|publisher=Academic }}</ref>

== Awards ==
* Jean Leray award in 1989 for the work in his PhD thesis<ref name=":0" />
* Professor de Kleijn award in 1989 for the work in his PhD thesis
* George Winter senior scientist award in 1997<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.esbiomaterials.eu/Cms/Content/7|title=ESB European Society for Biomaterials|website=esbiomaterials.eu|access-date=1 February 2018|archive-date=8 November 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211108192658/http://www.esbiomaterials.eu/Cms/Content/7}}</ref>
* Federa award in 2012<ref>{{cite web|title=Federaprijs-winnaars – Federa|url=https://www.federa.org/federaprijs-winnaars|website=federa.org}}</ref>
* "Most entrepreneurial scientist" award in 2012<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=News_van Blitterswijk most entrepreneurial scientist in 2012 |url=https://www.utwente.nl/en/news/!/2012/6/260057/van-blitterswijk-voted-most-entrepreneurial-scientist-of-the-netherlands |access-date=1 February 2018}}</ref>
* Career Achievement award of the EU Chapter of the Tissue Engineering and Regenerative Medicine International Society in 2013<ref>{{Cite web|title=TERMIS|url=https://www.termis.org/chapters_eu.php|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170707121227/https://www.termis.org/chapters_eu.php|archive-date=7 July 2017|access-date=1 February 2018}}</ref>
* Huibregtsen award in 2015<ref name="avondwenm.nl">{{cite web |title=Over de prijs |url=http://www.avondwenm.nl/huibregtsenprijs/over-de-prijs |website=avondwenm.nl}}</ref>
* ESB Klaas de Groot award in 2021<ref>{{Cite web|title=ESB European Society for Biomaterials|url=https://www.esbiomaterials.eu/Cms/Content/7|access-date=2021-11-15|website=www.esbiomaterials.eu}}</ref>
